_doc: Push path SHADOW (audits/overnight-1016/report.md latency cuts (a)+(b)): the desk streams card updates (SSE, /api/desk/card-stream) and the watcher measures signal -> decision latency on the push path next to its poll path. Target < 10 s from the 1m/5m bar close to the decision. NOT part of shared/desk-rules.json, so RULES_HASH is unchanged. The stream is OFF unless DESK_PUSH_SHADOW=1 on the site; the watcher listener is OFF unless DESK_PUSH_SHADOW=1 on the box. live=false: push events never reach gates or firing.
